title: Figure 12: Tic Tac parametric velocities vs. event duration (mph)
description: Scatter plot titled "Tic Tac Parametric Velocities for Selected Times of Event Duration (Points are Not Continuous)" with velocity (mph, 0 to 90,000) against time (seconds, 0 to 10). Values decline from about 82,000 mph at 0.5 s to roughly 4,000 mph at 10 s. The caption reads "Figure 12. Tic Tac Parametric Velocities for Selected Times of Event Duration in mph" (BAASS UAP Analysis Capabilities report, page 36).
